# Rediff.com

> > Rediff.com is India's leading digital media and services platform offering news, financial markets, email services, video streaming, and expert advice across sports, entertainment, and lifestyle.

Rediff.com is a comprehensive Indian news and services portal founded in 1996, combining real-time financial market data, breaking news coverage, enterprise email solutions, and entertainment streaming. The platform serves millions of users with integrated services spanning business news, cricket and sports coverage, and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- News Portal
- Stock Market & BSE/NSE
- Business News
- Cricket Updates
- Sports Coverage
- Rediffmail Enterprise Email
- Video Streaming
- Expert Advice Platform
- India News
- Breaking News
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- Middle East Tensions
- Personal Finance
- Bollywood & Entertainment
- Live Scores

## Core Services & Platforms

- [Rediff.com Homepage](https://www.rediff.com): Rediff.com main portal with integrated access to news, email, stocks, and expert advice services
- [Rediff Money - Live Stock Market](https://money.rediff.com/index.html): Live BSE/NSE stock quotes, mutual funds, portfolio tracking, and stock market analysis
- [Rediffmail for Work](https://workmail.rediff.com): Enterprise email, video conferencing, and cloud-based collaboration platform made in India
- [Rediffmail Business Email](https://businessemail.rediff.com): Secure business email service with domain registration, security features, and flexible pricing plans
- [Rediff-TV Video Streaming](https://tv.rediff.com): Video streaming platform for news, movies, sports, cricket, and lifestyle content
- [rediffGURUS Expert Advice](https://gurus.rediff.com): Q&A platform connecting users with experts for advice on career, health, relationships, and personal matters

- [Rediff News - Latest Headlines](https://www.rediff.com/news): India and international news coverage including politics, breaking news, and in-depth reporting
- [Iran Reports Attack on Nuclear Site](https://www.rediff.com/news/report/iran-reports-attack-on-nuclear-site-no-radiation-leak/20260321.htm): Iran's Natanz nuclear facility attacked; IAEA confirms no radiation leak reported

- [Iran Fires Missiles at US-UK Base in Indian Ocean](https://www.rediff.com/news/report/iran-fires-missiles-at-us-uk-base-4000-kms-away-in-indian-ocean/20260321.htm): Iran launches ballistic missiles at Diego Garcia US-UK military base in Indian Ocean Region
- [Iran's Consul-General Interview on Military Escalation](https://www.rediff.com/news/interview/irans-consul-general-we-hold-the-upper-handirans-consul-general-we-hold-the-upper-hand/20260321.htm): Iran's Consul-General claims military reserves remain untapped amid Middle East conflict escalation
- [Iranian Cluster Bomb Attack Damages Kindergarten in Israel](https://www.rediff.com/news/report/iranian-cluster-bomb-attack-damages-kindergarten-in-israel/20260321.htm): Iran's cluster bomb attack damages kindergarten in central Israel; no casualties reported
